use_extra_extension: use the ExtraExtension class to register PHP Markdown Extra-style extensions on a Markdown instance
extend_markdown_with_extra: extend a Markdown instance with fenced code, footnotes, tables, abbr, def list, attr list, and md in HTML via ExtraExtension
make_extension: call makeExtension to create an ExtraExtension instance with keyword arguments for config
review_extensions_list: review the extensions list to see which Python-Markdown extensions are bundled by Extra
refactor_extra_extension: refactor ExtraExtension to add or remove bundled extensions from the extensions list
